page.overview:
Who is Narancia Ghirga?

Narancia Ghirga (ナランチャ・ギルガ Narancha Giruga) is an incarnation of the original Narancia from the 37th universe, he is a character featured in JORGE JOESTAR. He is a core ally and is a member of Passione. He assigned to by Giorno Giovanna to be Joji Joestar's partner when he is hired to find the Boss.

Unlike his original counterpart, he wields the Stand, U-Boat. It is taken and copied by Kars, with a DISC, who creates his own variant and gives U-Boat to Joji.

Like his original counterpart, Narancia maintains the same outfit and hairstyle. He is drawn with black wristbands, and wields a knife with the Passione symbol engraved on it.

U-Boat is a colony boat Stand that is able to travel inside Stands and people through their muscles and tissue, it also has military weapons and long ranged artillery. It can even travel through Narancia's body so he can use it as a shield. The Stand is also able to fly freely in the air.
